scope: Five-file shared Android authority adapter only; not the full prerequisite 66-file product integration or a real Android acceptance.

findings.finding: Memory's file-based loader and Quiz's normal import both select the new standalone shared helper. Neither final probe imports or inherits the current C4 probe. The allowed five-file set contains no existing C4 production or verifier path.

All fifteen geometry, JSON, PCK, navigation and small utility definitions are independently AST-identical to the bound published producer helper. The original helper Git blob is ffa5c6d9a0c8e4403847fd07e8436234f7af979e.

The new init checks candidate CWD and expected full Host HEAD, obtains its tree, rejects tracked changes, compares each selected file's actual bytes to git show HEAD:path, rejects missing/symlink/escaping/duplicate paths and binds its executing __file__. All six imported runtime modules plus the actual tour.probe/base/live module objects are checked against exact candidate paths. A second source binding must equal the first after import. Both game reports include the same binding again before and after the tour.

Memory now sets its existing 600-second deadline before entering the shared initializer; Quiz's existing 900-second initialization and enclosing bounded_runtime context are unchanged. New Git reads use positive remaining time capped at 30 seconds and check again after returning. Shared wait checks the local/global boundary after a positive observation; equality or lateness stays failure. Game-specific observation/input/deadline methods remain AST-identical.

The inherited PID reader permits exactly one positive native process ID. Tag generation stays unique per probe instance. Both unchanged run methods still require the same already-installed APK, actual source/PCK identities, all 21 prior main-tour steps, current owner/round/token, real captures and authority ACKs, durable save preservation, native-to-Flutter returns and same-round reopening. The adapter introduces no board/save/mailbox injection or replacement renderer.

The independent comparison found only Memory.__init__, Memory.binding and Memory.main changed, and only Quiz.binding changed. All 27 other Memory definitions, 38 other Quiz definitions and all 37 existing Quiz test/helper definitions are AST-identical; module-level changes are the explicit import/source-list wiring. Memory main now rejects any nonempty output rather than only a prior result.json.

All sixteen new test methods were read but not executed. They cover actual temporary Git source/tree/bytes, hidden tracked mutation, wrong helper/module path, symlink/duplicate/traversal inputs, post-read/local/global deadline boundaries, no import after expired init, one PID, full PCK stream/duplicate entry rejection, exact hub controls and ambiguity, real probe import pairing and rejection of existing output.

boundaries: No tests, product imports, renderer, emulator, ADB, Git command, network download or source edit was performed for this review.
The preceding native/Android/C4 results are not a Memory/Quiz acceptance result.
The frozen prerequisite Host66 product integration has not been independently reviewed in full by this five-file adapter review.
The new sixteen methods and eventual actual Android execution still require the separately published combined checkpoint and Root authorization.
Source binding covers the explicit helper/module/source list; this report does not claim that every transitive Python module was independently bound by module object identity.
The existing Memory source-binding subprocess calls outside the new helper were preserved; this review does not assert a newly added process-wide Memory alarm.
